description: Reviews Mori (cognition VCS) mutations — init, stage, checkout, merge, rebase, commit, reset, stash park/pop/drop, and branch — plus `show --raw` / `recall --raw` STTP dumps. `mori stash list` and `--help`/`-h` are safe variants of those rules. Other read subcommands are not matched by this source; base Guard policy still applies to the `mori` binary. Community coverage does not certify the upstream tool.
name: Mori cognition VCS command protection
saferAlternatives: Prefer mori status, log, show, recall, find, and compile to inspect cognition state before mutating it.
Stash or clear staged context before checkout, and list branches before creating one.
